snippet.title: Lords of the Fallen II: SGF Gameplay Teaser  | Wishlist Now on Steam, PS5, Xbox X|S, Epic & Switch 2
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, Epic & Nintendo Switch 2: https://linktr.ee/lordsofthefallen

Lords of the Fallen II is a dark fantasy action-RPG where brutal, soulslike combat collides with a world torn between life and death. Witness the evolution of Umbral, the realm of the dead, as its new form is revealed for the first time in this alpha gameplay footage.

One world. Two realms. No mercy.

Coming 2026.
